description: Log multiple intake entries in a single call. Requires explicit user intent (explicit_user_intent: true). Each item is processed through the same text-estimator pipeline as `nourish_log_intake`, but the entire batch shares one intent flag — perfect for Telegram users who say 'log everything I ate today: breakfast was X, lunch was Y, dinner was Z'. Returns per-item success/failure so a partial failure doesn't lose the rest.

explicit_user_intent.description: Pass true only after the user explicitly asked to save, log, set, or delete this personal nutrition data.

items.description: Array of meals to log atomically (1-20). Each item gets its own intake entry. The `explicit_user_intent` flag covers the entire batch.

name: nourish_bulk_log_intake
title: Bulk log intake
